ya10.3.3:1.1: (Ka) yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so domanassindriyaṃ pajahissatīti?
ya10.3.3:2.1: Dve puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissanti, no ca domanassindriyaṃ pajahissanti. Pañca puggalā cakkhundriyañca parijānissanti domanassindriyañca pajahissanti. (Kha)
ya10.3.3:3.1: yo vā pana domanassindriyaṃ pajahissati so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā. (Ka)
ya10.3.3:4.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessatīti?
ya10.3.3:5.1: Cha puggalā cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessanti. Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te cakkhundriyañca parijānissanti anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvessanti. (Kha)
ya10.3.3:6.1: yo vā pana anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessati so cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissatīti? Āmantā. (Ka)

ya10.3.3:9.1: yo cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati so aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarissatīti? Āmantā. (Kha)

ya10.3.3:11.1: Aggamaggasamaṅgī aññātāvindriyaṃ sacchikarissati, no ca cakkhundriyaṃ parijānissati. Satta puggalā aññātāvindriyañca sacchikarissanti cakkhundriyañca parijānissanti. (Cakkhundriyamūlakaṃ) (Ka)

ya10.3.3:13.1: Cattāro puggalā domanassindriyaṃ pajahissanti, no ca anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ bhāvessanti. Ye puthujjanā maggaṃ paṭilabhissanti te domanassindriyañca pajahissanti anaññātaññassāmītindriyañca bhāvessanti. (Kha)
